key_terms: Theoretical (Classical) Probability: P(E) = (Number of outcomes favourable to E) / (Number of all possible outcomes), assuming equally likely outcomes.
Equally likely outcomes: Outcomes having identical chance of occurrence.
Elementary Event: Event having only one outcome. Sum of probabilities of all elementary events in an experiment equals 1.
Complementary Events: Event 'not E' (E-bar) has probability P(E-bar) = 1 - P(E).
Impossible event has P = 0; Sure (certain) event has P = 1.
